our daughter was born at Darent Valley Hospital, and I just want to say a huge thank you to the incredible team who looked after us.

Before choosing Darent Valley, many friends advised me to avoid it and instead go to hospitals under King’s College Hospital, where my previous two children were born. However, we decided to give Darent Valley a try this time because everything is under one roof, appointments, scans, midwives, and delivery,
which makes life much easier for families.

From the very first appointment until today, the care has been absolutely amazing. The staff are welcoming, professional, and genuinely caring.

A special thank you to Dr Mishra, Dr Sherif Shazly, Grace Ogele, Yadav S., Tiffany Ricardo, Rupe Malati, Ruth Afolabi, and Sandra the midwife. The theatre team were calm, supportive, and incredibly professional.

Dr Sherif Shazly was phenomenal. As a fellow Egyptian, it was a funny coincidence for me to see another Sherif in the room! But beyond the shared name, his confidence and reassurance made the whole experience so much easier for my wife.

Before arriving today, my wife and I had agreed this would be our last child… but after the care we received here, we might have to rethink that decision!

Thank you Darent Valley Hospital for making such an important day in our lives so special.
